metadata.description: Country-year total population panels for testing how well Benford's law describes the leading digits of national populations. One example per entity-year. Primary panel: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via Our World in Data (1950-2025; estimates 1950-2023, 2024-2025 flagged as projections). Companion panel: World Bank WDI SP.POP.TOTL (1960-2025), independently sourced. Examples carry the published value plus per-row digit encodings, the pre-registered even/odd year fold, and the microstate / SIDS / top-20 ablation tags. No derived digit statistics.
metadata.do_not_pool_panels: WDI is sourced from national statistical offices for roughly one third of economies, so the companion panel tests source invariance, not the same numbers twice. Never concatenate the two datasets.
metadata.demo_subset: Curated demo subset of the primary panel only. 25 entities x 4 years (1950, 1975, 2000, 2023), 100 examples. Entities were taken every k-th from the alphabetically sorted primary-panel entity list, which is uncorrelated with population size or region, so the subset is a systematic spread rather than a hand-picked one. The companion World Bank WDI panel is deliberately excluded (the artifact's do_not_pool_panels rule).
